def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    insert = 0
    
    sb = list(str_input)
    i = 0
    while i < len(sb):
        c = sb[i]
        start = i
        while i < len(sb) and sb[i] == c:
            i += 1
        run_length = i - start
        if run_length % 2 == 0:
            insert += 1
    
    print(insert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
